end.parentNote: Kabir practised rounding numbers to estimate before finding an exact answer. They correctly explained that 4,982 rounds to 5,000 and 3,015 rounds to 3,000, giving an estimate of 8,000. They mixed up an estimate with the exact answer and continued to expect both numbers to match; this was not corrected by the end. At home, ask Kabir to label each result “estimate” or “exact” and discuss whether the exact answer is close to the estimate.
